{{Quote|I'm pretty sure I saw Doogal putting something by that gravestone over there. Maybe you should look around and see what's there.|Officer Nok, to a spacer|<ref name="AED" />}}
'''Nok''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|RNSF]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]] who lived on the lush [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Sometime after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Officer Nok was present at a small graveyard north of the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Keren/Legends|Keren]]. During this time, he reported to a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] that he had seen the wanted [[Maulers|Mauler]] leader by the name of [[Doogal Belstar]] put something by the [[Tombstone|gravestone]]. He suggested that a spacer working for [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Gregar Typho/Legends|Typho]] investigate it further. The investigation resulted in the [[Capture of Doogal Belstar|death]] of the criminal.<ref name="AED" />

==Behind the scenes==
Nok was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Nok was added to the game as part of the "[[W:c:swg:Legacy Quest|Legacy Quest]]" with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]," a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref>
